LanguageData.BSVPF_EnabledDesc: When off, every pawn draws Visible Pants exactly as it would without this mod.
LanguageData.BSVPF_Explanation: Checked items are drawn on pawns with that body, using the replacement texture where one exists. Unchecked items are hidden. Changes apply when this window closes.
LanguageData.BSVPF_NoBodies: No supported bodies found. None of the loaded mods add a gene that grants a snake, centaur or spider body (Big and Small - Genes & More adds all three).
